32cc2c4a0e.q: What are the key lessons Don Macari learned from over 200 jury trials in his 41-year legal career?
32cc2c4a0e.a: The biggest lesson is that trial work requires thorough preparation: you must know every fact, understand the rules of evidence, and build trust and rapport with the jury from the moment you enter the courtroom. Additionally, no trial ever goes exactly as planned, so lawyers must be ready to handle unexpected situations without showing stress. Trial work appears sexy on TV but in real life it demands intensive preparation, including many nights and weekends spent preparing openings and closings, and it is a stressful but rewarding profession.
32cc2c4a0e.e: Lessons from 40 Years in Law: Trial Preparedness, Client Trust, and Firm Growth

ff220a038f.q: How does the contributory negligence rule in North Carolina and Virginia compare to comparative negligence in other states?
ff220a038f.a: Contributory negligence in North Carolina, Virginia, and two other states bars recovery entirely if the plaintiff is found to have any negligence that contributes to the accident, whereas most states have comparative negligence where a plaintiff who is 20 percent at fault can still recover 80 percent of their damages. Macari described contributory negligence as a terribly harsh rule and stated that he and other trial lawyers associations try every year to get legislatures to change it because it is unfair and the first thing insurance adjusters use to argue against clients.

cb749f0373.a: Macari's first trial involved 10 Marines charged with attempted murder after performing a Code Red (blanket party) that injured Private Alvarado at Guantanamo Bay. f613c2ab79.q: What advice does Don Macari give to young attorneys starting their own law firms?
f613c2ab79.a: Macari advises young lawyers to find an area of law they are passionate about because legal practice is not a nine-to-five job and will consume much of their time. Most importantly, attorneys must treat law as both a profession and an honor profession, but also as a business by implementing proper management structures including a CFO, director of IT, director of advertising, and human resources director.
